name: Astron Energy Bursary 2027
whoItsFor: South African citizens under 35, with at least a 70% average; fields include engineering, IT, computer science, finance, accounting, commerce and data analytics.
documents: Certified ID documents of parents or guardians
Proof of other bursary or NSFAS funding where applicable
Certified academic records and registration proof where applicable
notes: Closes 12:00 midday on Monday 26 Oct 2026; several bursary listing sites agree on this date. Applications are online and the bursary is administered by Excel@Uni. We have not found an official Astron Energy page, so no link is shown. Listed fields differ between sites; check the application portal before applying. One 2027 listing names only data analytics, chemical engineering and electrical engineering as fields, so the field list may be narrower this year: check the portal.

name: NSFAS 2027
whoItsFor: Students at public universities and TVET colleges who qualify financially.
documents: Declaration or disability forms where applicable
Orphan and vulnerable child form where applicable
notes: Applications close on 31 October 2026 and NSFAS says there will be no extension (government and NSFAS statements, September to October 2026). The 18 November date mentioned at the launch event was replaced by 31 October. Apply through the myNSFAS portal. Free.

name: ISFAP Bursary 2027
whoItsFor: First-year undergraduates in 2027 from households earning R600,000 a year or less, accepted at a partner university, in selected fields.
documents: Signed ISFAP funding application consent form
Certified ID documents of parents, guardians and household earners
notes: Fields and partner universities change yearly. Confirm the portal status before applying.

name: JDK Benefit Trust Bursary 2027
whoItsFor: Black South African citizens aged 17 to 21, in matric or having finished first or second year, in eligible fields at recognised institutions.
documents: Documents listed on the official application form
notes: Sources disagree about the closing date. Confirm on the official application page.

name: Funza Lushaka Bursary 2027
whoItsFor: Students training to teach in priority subjects who need a university place and agree to teach after graduating.
documents: Certified copies of required documents; check the 2027 list
notes: The date shown is for new applicants; returning bursars may have a different deadline. Confirm before applying. The Department of Basic Education page still showed 2026 dates when checked on 24 October 2026, so the 2027 dates come from listings; confirm on eservices.gov.za.

name: DSTI-NRF Postgraduate Scholarships
whoItsFor: Postgraduate only (Honours, Master's, PhD). South African citizens and permanent residents with at least 65% in their previous degree. Age limits apply: 28 for Honours, 30 for Master's, 32 for PhD.
documents: Documents listed on the official application page
notes: Closing dates differ by level. UNISA's research office lists the NRF call dates as: first-time Master's and Doctoral closed 3 July 2026, and Master's and Doctoral extension support closed 14 August 2026. A November 2026 date for Honours was reported but is not confirmed. Reported: full cost of study for financially needy students (household income up to R350,000 a year) or students with disabilities, and partial cost for other qualifying candidates. Confirm the details on the funder's own page before applying.

name: UNISA Postgraduate Bursaries
whoItsFor: Postgraduate only (Postgraduate Diploma, Honours, Master's, Doctoral). Mainly South African citizens registered at UNISA. Students moving from an undergraduate degree into Honours need a 60% average.
documents: Documents listed on the official application page
notes: UNISA's page says the 2027 postgraduate bursary application period runs from 21 September to 30 November 2026. The funding is for UNISA students, and Master's and doctoral funding has research-stage requirements, so read the UNISA guidelines. Reported: tuition fees for Postgraduate Diploma and Honours students; Master's and doctoral students may also get research allowances. Confirm the details on the funder's own page before applying.

name: IDC External Bursary Scheme
whoItsFor: Postgraduate only (Honours and postgraduate CTA). Unemployed South African citizens with financial need, studying Law, Mathematics, Statistics, Actuarial Science or Accounting.
documents: Documents listed on the official application page
notes: Applications for 2027 closed on 30 September 2026 (IDC advert shared by NWU and several listings). Do not apply unless the IDC announces a reopening. Reported limits: household income up to R350,000 a year and age 26 or younger. The scheme mainly funds a first qualification. Reported: tuition, accommodation, meals, transport and a once-off laptop allowance. Confirm the details on the funder's own page before applying.

name: SANSA Postgraduate Bursary
whoItsFor: Postgraduate only (Honours, Master's, Doctoral). South African citizens studying relevant science and engineering qualifications, with an average of at least 65%.
documents: Documents listed on the official application page
notes: Reported: fixed yearly funding limits that differ by level (Honours, Master's, Doctoral). Details come from a summary and have not been checked against the funder's own page yet; confirm the closing date and rules before applying. SANSA's usual cycle is 1 to 31 October for the next year of study, and 31 October 2026 is the expected 2027 closing date, but it is not confirmed.

name: Canon Collins RMTF Scholarships
whoItsFor: Postgraduate only (Master's and PhD). Nationals of eligible Southern African countries studying in South Africa, in justice (climate justice, law, economics, politics), education policy or humanities.
documents: Documents listed on the official application page
notes: Stage 1 for 2027 has closed. The Canon Collins page text gives 14 August 2026 at 16:00, and some listings report an extension to 21 August 2026 at 16:00 SAST. Stage 2 is by invitation only. Reported: support for up to two years, with the option to reapply for a third year depending on performance. Watch for the next call. Confirm the details on the funder's own page before applying.

name: ISFAP Postgraduate Funding
whoItsFor: Postgraduate only (first postgraduate degree). South African citizens accepted at an ISFAP partner university who meet the academic and financial requirements set by the donors.
documents: Documents listed on the official application page
notes: Reported: a full package covering tuition, accommodation, a monthly living allowance and student support. This is separate from the undergraduate ISFAP bursary above. Details come from a summary and have not been checked against the funder's own page yet; confirm the closing date and rules before applying. A listing reports 31 October 2026 for selected programmes, but ISFAP funding is programme and university specific, so check your own programme on the portal.
